remarks:
This classic 1927 single family home embodies the historic development of the prestigious Eggertsville neighborhood  with a sense of permanence and strength, featuring original plaster walls, heavy oak hardwood flooring and trim, leaded glass windows, and robust structural framing. The charming and well-maintained home is ideally situated near the end of a quiet dead-end street.  With an all-brick exterior and attached 2-car garage, and exceptional privacy, this home blends historic character with modern updates. Key property features include the inviting curb appeal; a large, private, tree-lined lot in a tranquil neighborhood setting; an updated eat-in kitchen showcasing accented ivory-colored cabinetry, granite countertops, and ample space for casual dining; a large dining/multi-function room accessible from the kitchen as well as the light-filled curved arched entryway; hardwood floors running seamlessly throughout the home; an extra-large living/family room anchored by a cozy, traditional fireplace; 3 generously sized bedrooms with good closet space; a spacious primary bedroom featuring its own private fireplace; and a bright, airy 3-season sunroom providing the perfect spot to relax with your morning coffee while overlooking the peaceful backyard. The expansive, private backyard and patio offer endless possibilities for gardening, entertaining, or simply enjoying the serene surroundings.
Don't miss the opportunity to make this peaceful Amherst retreat your next home! Schedule your private showing today. All offers will be reviewed as they are received.
